data.one_liner: A flexible tooltip widget that aligns to its target with automatic fallback positioning.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to show arbitrary widget content inside a tooltip aligned along any axis. It features automatic fallback positioning to opposite sides when space runs out, along with support for modals, custom tails, and scroll integration.
use_when: You need custom widgets inside a tooltip instead of just plain text.
Tooltips need to automatically reposition themselves when they overflow the screen edges.
avoid_when: You only need standard simple text tooltips provided by Flutter's built-in Tooltip widget.
You need a well-established mature package rather than a direct fork under early development.
strengths: Supports arbitrary widget content and custom tail builders.
Automatic fallback to the opposite side on overflow.
Provides both overlay-based and non-overlay inline tree options.
weaknesses: API is subject to change as a direct fork under early versioning.
Requires recent Dart and Flutter SDK versions.
data.minimal_example:
AlignedTooltip(
  content: const Padding(
    padding: EdgeInsets.all(8.0),
    child: Text('Tooltip content'),
  ),
  child: const Icon(Icons.add),
)
